LESSON: SAUM ,

Grade: Grade 7
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Devotional Acts
Topic 4.3: Saum ,

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Saum ,. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: What are the benefits of Saum in the life of a Muslim?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. describe types of Saum for ease of observance
2. observe saum to earn rewards from Allah
3. appreciate the observance of Saum as a way of earning taqwa

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE STUDYING: SAUM ,
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION · Grade: Grade 7
This is a learner study lesson (not a teacher guide). Read every part, follow the models, then practise.

BIG PICTURE
Saum , helps you succeed in ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION. You will understand it, practise it, and use it at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

KEY FACTS: SAUM ,
Study Saum , like a learner textbook page: meaning → examples → practice → check.
Replace teacher words with your own words.
If a step is unclear, rewrite it shorter and try again.

PART 1: Describe types of Saum for ease of observance

What this means
In this part you learn to describe types of Saum for ease of observance. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: describe types of Saum for ease of observance.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Value in action: Show how “Saum ,” looks when you treat a classmate kindly.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can describe types of Saum for ease of observance. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 2: Observe saum to earn rewards from Allah

What this means
In this part you learn to observe saum to earn rewards from Allah. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: observe saum to earn rewards from Allah.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Story link: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Saum , in your own words.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can observe saum to earn rewards from Allah. Write or say your answer clearly.

PART 3: Appreciate the observance of Saum as a way of earning taqwa

What this means
In this part you learn to appreciate the observance of Saum as a way of earning taqwa. You will use ideas from at home, at your place of worship, and at school.

How to learn it
1. Read the idea carefully: appreciate the observance of Saum as a way of earning taqwa.
2. Reflect, retell, then practise a good habit using a Kenyan example from your life.
3. Check yourself: Can you explain it without looking?

Model
Daily habit: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson.

Your turn
Do one short practice that proves you can appreciate the observance of Saum as a way of earning taqwa. Write or say your answer clearly.

PUT IT TOGETHER
Close your notes and say aloud: what Saum , is, one example, and one way you will practise this week.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Show how “Saum ,” looks when you treat a classmate kindly. (skill: describe types of Saum for ease of observance)

Example 2: Retell a short faith/values story connected to Saum , in your own words. (skill: observe saum to earn rewards from Allah)

Example 3: Choose one good action to practise today because of this lesson. (skill: appreciate the observance of Saum as a way of earning taqwa)

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Write 5 sentences (or show 5 clear steps) that teach Saum , to a classmate.
2. Practise this skill: describe types of Saum for ease of observance.
3. Practise this skill: observe saum to earn rewards from Allah.
4. Practise this skill: appreciate the observance of Saum as a way of earning taqwa.
5. Make one local Kenya example of Saum , from your county, market, farm, or school.
6. Mark your own work: What did you get right? What will you redo?

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. In your exercise book, make a one-page revision sheet for Saum ,: meaning, 3 examples, 5 practice items.
2. Teach a parent/guardian or younger sibling one part of this lesson (2 minutes).
3. Answer in writing: Why should a Grade 7 learner study Saum ,?
4. Prepare for the quiz: cover the Remember box and recite it.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What are the benefits of Saum in the life of a Muslim?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. Know what Saum , means in your own words.
2. Use local Kenyan examples, not only definitions.
3. Practise in small steps, then check your work.
4. Be able to: describe types of Saum for ease of observance.
5. Be able to: observe saum to earn rewards from Allah.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
